description: Diagnostic paysager des voies navigables appartenant à la région Bretagne is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by applications.region-bretagne.fr. In 2019, the Direction des Voies Navigables launched a landscape study on the 425 km of waterways owned and managed by the Brittany Region. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Landscape diagnosis of waterways belonging to the Brittany region" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include données ouvertes. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
